title: A Great Overview of Barcelona
text: A great way to experience Barcelona in a day. Hit the major highlights of the city with excellent guides.
author: John_K

title: Take this tour! You will be glad!
text: This was a great tour, explaining so much history. Our tour guide was Rocco, and his knowledge was incredible. We enjoyed every minute. Partial bus tour, partial walking. Barcelona is an amazing, cultural experience. I am so glad we took this tour. Self tour would have been incomplete without all this experience and historical knowledge.
author: NanP596

title: The guides hit all of the...
text: The guides hit all of the major spots while giving excellent insight into each location. They gave enough time to explore while keeping us on schedule.
author: Peter_L

title: The Barcelona High Points
text: Angie & Miro are very in formed of the History of Barcellona.   They answered any questions that we had with very professional knowledge about their subjects.  Mucho Bueno
author: J5167LDalanc

title: Must Do Barcelona Highlights
text: Angie & Miro were wonderful & full of energy. They were full of knowledge & recommendations. The experience was diverse including Gothic Quarter, port areas, Park Guell, Olympic Village, Familia Sagrada.
author: C8461JBgregb

title: Great tour
text: It was a perfect way to see a large swath of Barcelona and get recommendations Angie was a wonderful guide! So informative and also entertaining! Excellent in every way!!!! Also felt safe and secure on and off bus
author: Aggiemom14

title: Barcelona Tour
text: Angie and Miro were great. Highly recommended.
author: I8949ELdavidb

title: AAA for 3 guides with mad skills!
text: Xavi (pronounced Chavi) was a great guide with a wonderful sense of humor!  Knowledgeable and on point with history, food and fun facts, you can’t go wrong with this tour. All 3 guides were superb!
author: Dukoach

title: Angelika and Paulina - the best guides ever!!!
text: Good planning and organization, but the best were the guides - Angelika and Paulina. They have wide knowlege and present it with a lot of humour. I hope my next trips in Barcelona will be guided by them!!!
author: Aleksandra_K
